resolution: Fixed the TileBody crash caused by stale persisted active tile names after the population-tile cleanup. Session restore now normalizes old active paint tiles to a real ground paint surface, excluding water and embedded profiles, and PropertiesPanel now guards stale tile focus values instead of dereferencing an undefined tile definition.
